title: Identify the actual column law with normalized Euclidean surface probability
source_anchor: Appendix B.2.2 Proposition B.7 proof: O e_1 is uniform on the unit sphere, before applying Lemma A.1 to U=O_11; Eq21–24 selected Gaussian kernel, actual normalized Euclidean surface-law identification component
target_statement: For natural \(n\ge3\) and real \(\kappa\ge4\), use the literal selected \(s,r,\ell,\beta\), actual precision \(A_O\), Gaussian \(\gamma_O\), signed expectation \(H_\gamma(\ell)\), and kernel \(f\) defined below. Let \(\nu=(O\mapsto Oe_1)_*\mu\) for actual normalized full orthogonal Haar. Let \(\tau=\mathrm{vol}.\mathrm{toSphere}\) on the actual Euclidean unit sphere, and \(\sigma=\tau(S)^{-1}\iota_*\tau\). Then \(\nu=\sigma\), \(\sigma\) is a probability, \(f\in L^1(\sigma)\), and \(H_\gamma(\ell)=\beta\int f\,d\sigma\). The parameters are \(s=\sqrt\kappa\), \(r=(1-1/n)(s-1)/(s+1)\), \(\ell=(4ns+(s-1)^2)/(8n(n-1))\), \(\beta=(-1)^{n-1}(s-1)^{n-1}(1-1/n)^{n/2}/(s+1)^n\). Here \(f(y)=((s+1)y_1-(s-1))/(1+r^2-2ry_1)^{n/2}\), \(A_O=((\kappa+1)/2)I-((\kappa-1)/4)(O+O^\top)\), \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\), and \(H_\gamma(\ell)=\mathbb E_\mu[\det(O)\int e^{-\ell\|x\|_2^2}\,d\gamma_O]\). Real \(n/2\) powers are retained. Neither Poisson value nor evaluated Eq24 is asserted.
